title: Tiered Thermostat for Curated Batching Rollout with OPA Approval
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: implement a tiered 'thermostat' gating system for automatic adoption of batching and KV-cache recommendations from Optimize. The thermostat concept dynamically opens or restricts rollout pressure based on live telemetry (latency SLOs, cost-savings delta, error rates, and quality regressions) and enforces a policy decision via Open Policy Agent (OPA) before any config is applied to customer endpoints. This ticket covers the orchestration layer, policy integration, canary sequencing, and operator approval UX hooks required for safe auto-apply and accountable rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Policy-driven gate using OPA that can accept/reject a recommendation payload with an audit trail
A three-stage rollout sequence: dry-run (simulated traffic), micro-canary (1-5% traffic), gradual ramp (5-50%) with telemetry thresholds
Thermostat controller that throttles ramping when any telemetry threshold breaches (latency p95, token cost delta, error-rate, quality checks)
Operator approval flow surfaced in Console with explicit OPA decision and audit log link before ramp >5%
Automated rollback triggers that execute a reversible config change within 60s of breach detection
End-to-end tests (integration + synthetic canary) and a simulation mode that validates policy behavior without touching live configs
PR, Confluence design doc, and runbook linked in ticket
implementation_plan: Design proto: define thermostat thresholds, policy schema, and decision payload (owner: Maya)
OPA integration library: small service to evaluate policies against suggestion metadata and telemetry snapshot (owner: Liam)
Thermostat controller service: sequencer that advances canary phases based on metric windows and OPA responses
Console hooks: show pending recommendations, OPA decision rationale, and explicit approve/deny buttons; wire operator comment capture
Simulated-run mode: support evaluate-only path that records outcomes in a test namespace
Create reversible config companion (apply + staged-revert manifest) stored in S3 and versioned in GitHub
Instrumentation: add granular spans and metrics (thermostat.stage, opa.decision, rollout.rate) and tracing hooks to existing tracing pipeline
Safety checks: build fast circuit-breaker to halt rollouts in case of runaway regressions
testing_plan: Unit tests for OPA policy loader and decision interface
Integration test: suggestion -> OPA accept -> simulated dry-run produces expected savings estimate
Synthetic canary harness: replay recorded traffic with golden prompts to measure quality (BLEU/ROUGE-like proxies and hallucination heuristics)
Chaos test: force latency spike and ensure thermostat halts ramp and triggers rollback
End-to-end smoke: Console approve flow applies change and creates audit entry; deny flow cancels application
Load test: verify controller scales when evaluating 100 concurrent suggestions across Dedicated customers
observability: Dashboard: thermostat status per-customer with current stage, recent metric windows, and last OPA decision
Alerting: SLO breach alert + thermostat stalls for >5 minutes
Logs: structured audit entry for every state transition (include suggestion id, operator id, decision id)
Tracing: trace id linking suggestion -> OPA eval -> apply action -> rollback if triggered
rollback_playbook: Immediate: thermostat issues reverse-config commit and triggers canary rollback for affected routes
Operator: Console shows single-click emergency rollback and documents reason automatically
Postmortem: automated incident draft with metrics snapshot captured at time of rollback
Fallback model: if rollback fails, route traffic to preconfigured fallback model variant with compatible quantization/profile
